git-submodules.description: Both are required: enabledManagers filters the manager name list, while the enabled flag is a separate gate read from the manager's own defaultConfig, where git-submodules ships as enabled:false.

packageRules.description: The shared-configuration mounts, grouped into one proposal so a config advance carrying many skill changes never produces more than one PR here. No schedule: the pointer advances as soon as the config repo moves. Rate is bounded by prConcurrentLimit/prHourlyLimit rather than by a delay. branchConcurrentLimit and prHourlyLimit are 0 (unlimited) for this group only. branchConcurrentLimit silently INHERITS prConcurrentLimit when unset, so a repo limit of 5 against the 5 to 10 renovate branches these repos already carry produced 'Reached branch limit - skipping branch creation' and the pointer never moved. Repo-level limits still govern ordinary dependency updates; this one grouped branch is exempt so it cannot queue behind a backlog.

Every other submodule in this repo stays manual. Enabling the git-submodules manager must not silently start advancing pointers this change never considered, such as documentation mounts under product-docs/.
